name: JNJ-26489112
summary: JNJ-26489112 is an anticonvulsant drug being developed by Johnson & Johnson for the treatment of epilepsy. JNJ-26489112 was designed as a successor to topiramate. It is expected to have fewer side effects than topiramate because it lacks activity against carbonic anhydrase.

pharmacology.text: Its mechanism of action is unknown.

uses.text: JNJ-26489112 is an anticonvulsant drug being developed by Johnson & Johnson for the treatment of epilepsy. JNJ-26489112 was studied as a treatment for major depressive disorder.
